T: Never too old for a second helping.
D: A reckless LA cop is partnered with a family man about to turn fifty.
P: Serve the mains at Roger's birthday dinner, when Riggs meets the family.
S: Soft milk bread rolls proved twice and baked golden, brushed with melted honey butter and finished with flaky salt, served warm in a basket. Warm 250ml milk with 40g butter and 2 tbsp caster sugar to blood heat, then add 7g dried yeast and 1 egg. Mix into 500g bread flour with 1 tsp salt and knead 8 minutes. Prove 1 hour until doubled. Shape into 12 balls in a greased tin and prove 30 minutes more. Bake at 190C for 18 minutes. Melt 30g butter with 1 tbsp honey, brush over the hot rolls and sprinkle with flaky salt.
Sharp cheddar slabs, folded salami, saltines and pickled jalapeños
Saltine crackers with slabs of sharp cheddar, folded salami and pickled jalapeños, served straight off a chopping board.
Baked cream cheese and sour cream dip with crab and cheddar, crackers
Warm crab and cream cheese dip with a cheddar crust, scooped up with crackers. Mix 250g cream cheese, 150g sour cream, 2 tsp Worcestershire and a squeeze of lemon.
M: Beef chuck braised with onion, carrot, celery, tomato paste and red wine
Beef chuck browned in batches, onion, carrot, celery and tomato paste, deglazed with red wine, stock and thyme, braised at 150C for 3 hours. Mash.

Brined turkey breast roasted juicy, with sage cornbread stuffing, roast sweet potato and a proper pan gravy. Brine a 1.5kg turkey breast overnight in 2 litres water with 100g salt and 50g brown sugar. Pat dry, rub with butter and roast at 170C for about 75 minutes until it reads 70C inside, then rest 15 minutes. Mix 300g crumbled cornbread with 1 diced onion and 2 celery sticks softened in butter, chopped sage, 1 egg and 200ml stock, and bake 30 minutes. Roast 800g sweet potato wedges alongside. Make gravy from the pan juices, 1 tbsp flour and 300ml stock.
W: Two-layer chocolate cake filled and covered with chocolate buttercream
Chocolate butter cake baked in two layers at 170C for 35 minutes, filled and covered in chocolate buttercream, fifty candles if you have the nerve.
K: Cold lager with lime, tomato juice, hot sauce and a chili salt rim

Ice-cold lager mixed with lime, hot sauce, Worcestershire and tomato juice in a chilli salt-rimmed glass, finished with a lime wedge. Mix 2 tbsp salt with 1 tsp chilli powder on a plate. Rub the rims of 4 glasses with lime and dip in the chilli salt, then fill with ice. Into each glass add 30ml lime juice, 60ml tomato juice, 4 dashes hot sauce and 2 dashes Worcestershire sauce. Top each with a 375ml bottle of cold lager poured slowly and stir once. Garnish with lime wedges.
